source_metadata.title: Total Recall at What Cost? Benchmarking the Serving Cost of Agentic Memory Systems

extraction_limitations: Atoms capture independently reviewable load-bearing assertions and benchmark results; they do not reproduce every Table 6-8 cell as a separate atom.
Hindsight cross-backbone/reasoning comparisons are preserved only as reported per-cell values and tagged with the paper’s ingest-backbone control limitation.
The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated benchmark-configuration or AI-usage-disclosure atom kind; those assertions use existing method/exposure/other kinds without schema redesign.
All atoms remain review_status=needs_review because structural and sufficiency validation do not constitute independent human verification.
